messages.content: You are an experienced graduate recruiter screening CVs for a UK finance firm.

Job description:
Graduate Analyst, Finance (London)

About the role
We are recruiting graduates into a twelve-month analyst programme based in our
London office. Analysts support the finance team on management reporting,
budgeting and forecasting, and work with the commercial teams on cost and
margin analysis. The programme rotates through financial planning, commercial
finance and treasury, and leads to a permanent analyst post on successful
completion.

What you will do
- Prepare monthly management accounts and write the variance commentary
- Build and maintain cash-flow and cost models in Excel
- Reconcile ledgers and investigate differences
- Pull data for ad hoc commercial analysis and present findings to managers
- Support the annual budget and the quarterly reforecast

What we are looking for
- A degree in any discipline, achieved or expected at 2:1 or above
- Strong numeracy and confidence working with large spreadsheets
- Clear written and spoken communication, including with non-finance colleagues
- Accuracy under deadline pressure
- An interest in training towards a professional accountancy qualification
  (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), which we fund

Selection
Applications are screened on the CV, followed by a numerical test and two
interviews.

Below are two CVs for this role.

=== CANDIDATE 1 ===
Sarah Thompson
sarah.thompson@gmail.com | 07700 900412

Personal Profile
Mathematics graduate with a summer of analysis work at a water utility, building demand forecasts from meter data. Looking for a graduate analyst position where statistical modelling and clear reporting matter.

Education
University of Manchester, 2023–2026
BSc (Hons) Mathematics, 2:1
Modules: Linear Algebra, Programming with Python, Linear Regression Models, Time Series Analysis

Secondary school, 2016–2023
A-levels: Mathematics (A), Further Mathematics (A), Physics (A)
GCSEs: 10 GCSEs at grades 9–6, including Mathematics and English

Awards: Subject prize, Mathematics

Work Experience
Data Analyst Intern, Pennine Water Services (Jul–Sep 2025)
- Analysed smart-meter readings from 25,000 households in Python to estimate seasonal demand
- Built a forecasting spreadsheet in Excel that the planning team adopted for its winter review
- Presented findings to a team of eight engineers and analysts

Treasurer, Manchester University Mathematics Society (Sep 2024–Jun 2025)
- Managed a budget of £3,200 and kept the accounts for 11 events
- Prepared the year-end financial summary for the society's committee

Skills
Excel (forecasting, pivot tables), Python (NumPy, pandas), R, SQL, data cleaning, PowerPoint

Interests
Swimming, films, podcasts
